description: A painted scene of a bearded, long-haired man in a torn tan robe, wrists shackled in front of him, walked between two helmeted guards with spears and a curved blade. Behind them stands a stepped, ramped ziggurat, and to the left a mudbrick town burns under heavy smoke. More armed men follow in the background. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible frame, and I see no legible lettering.
